added.title: Embedded Software Engineer
added.description:
About the role

You'll build the software that makes Cortex a dependable industrial controller. Your work will span the controller runtime, embedded Linux services, and interfaces to physical hardware. You'll own implementation, integration, testing, and debugging through deployment.
Cortex runs on fixed hardware. The board sets the memory, CPU, and latency budget, and your code has to work within it. You'll need to understand what happens beneath an API: how code executes, where data lives, how memory is accessed, and how software communicates with hardware.
You'll work directly with the founders, electrical engineers, and application team to turn software into dependable machine behavior.

What you'll build

Develop software for the Cortex runtime and the services that execute controller applications.
Integrate industrial I/O, peripherals, and device communication with electrical and controls engineers.
Build reliable interfaces between applications, embedded Linux services, the runtime, and hardware.
Diagnose failures across software and hardware using instrumentation, traces, profiling, logs, and bench measurements.
Improve latency, memory use, CPU use, concurrency, and recovery behavior within fixed hardware limits.
Validate functionality and failure handling through automated tests, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and reproducible fault cases.
Ship controller updates and diagnostics that make deployment and field troubleshooting dependable.

What you've already proven

Deep C fundamentals.
You understand more than syntax. You can reason about pointers, memory allocation, buffer layout, object lifetimes, and how your code maps to machine instructions and hardware behavior. C++ and Rust experience are welcome alongside that foundation.
Understanding of how software interacts with hardware.
You can explain how software reads, writes, and controls physical devices, and how memory, timing, and hardware interfaces affect correctness.
Hands-on implementation and debugging.
You can walk through code you personally wrote, a difficult failure you investigated, the tools you used, and how you established that your fix worked.
Engineering within fixed resources.
You've made software work within concrete memory, processing, or timing limits. You measure behavior, identify the constraint, and improve the implementation.
Ownership and collaboration.
You take responsibility for working software, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and work effectively across software and electrical engineering.

Your experience should demonstrate these fundamentals through concrete projects. Familiarity with C syntax, Linux tools, or scripting alone is not enough.

Experience we especially value

Microcontroller or bare-metal firmware work involving registers, memory-mapped I/O, interrupts, and direct hardware interaction.
Embedded Linux runtimes, device drivers, board support packages, or debugging across application, operating-system, and hardware boundaries.
Industrial automation, robotics, or device communication using protocols such as CAN, Modbus, SPI, I²C, or UART.
Hardware-in-the-loop testing, real-time systems, controller updates, or diagnostics for deployed devices.
Performance-critical mobile, iOS, game-engine, or GPU software involving substantial memory management, optimization, and fixed hardware constraints.

Your background does not need to follow a traditional embedded engineering path. We welcome engineers from other disciplines who can demonstrate the same C, memory, hardware, and debugging fundamentals.

A computer engineering degree or research background is a plus, not a requirement. What matters is demonstrated technical depth and an interest in understanding how computers and hardware work.

Interview process

Recruiter conversation.
30-minute technical screen focused on C fundamentals, memory, buffers, debugging, and how software interacts with hardware.
Onsite with the team.

The Data Engineer works within the Data & Analytics organization as part of the Warehousing & Pipelines team. This role is responsible for designing, developing, modernizing, and supporting enterprise data integration solutions that power operational processes, analytics, reporting, machine learning, and enterprise data initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with deep data platform expertise and is passionate about building reliable, scalable, and maintainable data systems using modern engineering practices. This position offers opportunities for advancement for a well-qualified, driven candidate.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Birmingham, AL; Cedar Falls; IA; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; or Monett, MO.

About The Role

What if you could get paid to work on the project you've been meaning to build — with a state-of-the-art AI coding assistant at your side, completely free of charge?

We're looking for software developers in the New York area to bring their own projects and build them using an AI-powered coding assistant. You write real code on real projects you care about. We learn from your expert judgment on how the assistant performed. You keep full ownership of everything you build.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed for developers who want to ship their own work — and get compensated for it.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Fully Remote
Commitment: Flexible

What You'll Do

Bring a software project you personally own — a side project, a tool, an open-source library, or something you've been meaning to finish
Build features, fix bugs, refactor code, write docs, or do whatever your project needs — using an AI coding assistant
At each step, compare two versions of the assistant's response, choose the better one, and write a brief explanation of your reasoning
Work in your own environment, on your own schedule, with your own tools

Who You Are

A developer with a software project you personally own, stored in a git repository
Comfortable working in the terminal and with git-based workflows
Running macOS, Linux, or Windows with WSL2
Able to write clear, honest evaluations — you'll explain your choices in a few sentences
Self-motivated and reliable when working independently
Open-source maintainers are especially welcome

What's Eligible

Software projects that you personally and solely own
Open-source projects with an approved license
If your project has other maintainers, mention it in your application — we'll confirm eligibility

What's Not Eligible

Work owned by an employer, client, university, company, or startup
Projects under NDA
AI model training or evaluation projects; ML infrastructure
Security exploit tooling
Projects that process other people's personal data

Good to Know

Before starting, you'll sign short contributor terms and we'll approve your project
Transcripts of your coding sessions are used to improve AI models and cannot be withdrawn after submission — this covers sessions only, not the rest of your codebase
Your ratings and written feedback become part of the project's deliverables
During sessions: no passwords, API keys, or other people's personal data — and you write your ratings yourself, without AI help

Why You'll Love This

Your project, your code — you keep full ownership of everything, including code the assistant writes for you
Free AI tokens — your AI usage during sessions is fully covered, no subscription or API bill needed
Paid to build what you'd build anyway — real compensation for real development work on your own project
Fully remote and flexible — work from your own computer, on your own schedule
Shape the future of AI-assisted coding — your expert judgment directly improves the next generation of developer tools

Description

We are seeking a skilled Database Engineer to join our team within the Windreich Department of AI and Human Health and Institute for Critical Care Medicine (ICCM). In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust datamarts, data warehouses, databases and data visualization platforms for healthcare data. You will utilize your expertise in database management systems, to work with both current ETL/Data Warehousing and future Big Data/Streaming/Pipeline architectures. The focus will be on choosing optimal solutions to use for these purposes, then implementing, maintaining, and monitoring them, always being mindful of the overarching goal of accelerating translational research and improving clinical care.

Responsibilities

Facilitate data collection from a variety of different sources, getting it in the right formats, assuring that it adheres to data quality standards, and assuring that downstream users can get that data quickly and with a common standard interface.
Ensure that data streams/pipelines are scalable, repeatable, and secure, and can serve multiple users.
Design and develop a comprehensive datamart framework and data visualization platforms for healthcare data, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and data integrity.
Manage and administer databases on relational database management systems such as Postgres or Microsoft SQL Server, optimizing performance and ensuring high availability.
Develop and implement Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes to seamlessly integrate healthcare data from sources including Epic Inc's Caboodle and Clarity databases into the data mart.
Apply AI agents to data engineering work, including pipeline development, SQL generation, data quality checks, documentation, and natural language access to databases.
Responsible for creating the infrastructure that provides insight from raw data and handles diverse sources of data seamlessly.
Additional responsibilities include developing prototypes and proof of concepts for the selected solutions, and implementing complex big data projects with a focus on collecting, parsing, and managing large sets of data using multiple platforms to allow for Operational, Research and Data Science initiatives.
Translate business requirements into modern data pipeline solutions. Create centralized documents and diagrams of all solutions.
Design and implement monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery of data systems.
Create a data catalog store of all metadata.
Responsible for the integrity and security of data in all forms of storage throughout the Data Architecture. Ensure compliance with the Institutional Review Board and HIPAA to follow all applicable policies and procedures.
Assist in the development of standards and procedures affecting data management, design and maintenance. Documents all standards and procedures.
Possess an extremely flexible attitude. Willing to work with multiple types of technologies and languages with an open mind and without technology bias. Continuous interest in updating skill sets and knowledge of trends in the Big Data Technology space. Work closely with cross-functional teams including data scientists, healthcare providers, and IT professionals to understand data requirements, develop solutions, and support data-driven decision-making.

And other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; Advanced degree preferred.
4+ years relevant professional development experience, preferably in a LINUX environment.
Strong SQL and NoSQL Database Knowledge: Oracle, PostgreSQL/MYSQL, and Mongo DB (or similar).
Proficiency with at least 2 programming languages among Scala/Python/ Java. Must be flexible and fast to pick up new languages.
Proficiency in Restful service development, preferably with Node JS, Django and PHP.
Experience with micro-services and SOA.
Strong SQL and NoSQL Database Knowledge: Oracle, PostgreSQL/MYSQL, and Mongo DB (or similar).
Proficiency on installation and configuration of big data software and technology
Knowledge of Hadoop, Spark, Kafka and other big data technology stacks and streaming tools.
Familiarity with and the ability to leverage a wide variety of open source technologies and tools.
Working knowledge of cloud architecture and implementation onAzure or AWS, is a big plus. Experience with serverless computing, creating VMs, cloud security, and other cloud services is also a big plus.
Experience working in an Agile methodology. Experience working with JIRA is a plus.

Preferred

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
Strong proficiency in ETL processes, data warehousing, and data integration techniques with proven experience in database development and management
Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL.
At least 2 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines from Epic Clarity and Caboodle, with working knowledge of their data models. Epic Clarity or Caboodle Data Model certification preferred.
Proficiency in Python and experience with modern data engineering tools, including cloud lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or Microsoft Fabric), orchestration and transformation tools (Airflow, dbt), and Git-based CI/CD.
Experience using AI agents or LLM-based tools for database and data engineering tasks is strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of cloud architecture and implementation on Azure or AWS, is a big plus. Experience with serverless computing, creating VMs, cloud security, and other cloud services is also a big plus.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team environment.

Employer Description

Strength through Unity and Inclusion

The Mount Sinai Health System is committed to fostering an environment where everyone can contribute to excellence. We share a common dedication to delivering outstanding patient care. You enjoy writing software and seeing people use it.

Monitor system health and availability, investigate failures, complete or support root cause analyses, and implement corrective actions that reduce repeat events and operating risk.

Provide technical direction to contractors, integrators, vendors, and consultants; verify that work meets approved scope, company standards, safety requirements, documentation expectations, and acceptance criteria.

Partner with information technology and cybersecurity resources to protect operational technology systems through approved network architecture, access controls, secure remote access, patching, backup and recovery, vulnerability response, and incident-response practices. Promptly escalate suspected cybersecurity events, unauthorized changes, or system vulnerabilities.
Exercise stop-work authority and promptly communicate conditions that could affect employee safety, environmental protection, product integrity, regulatory compliance, cybersecurity, or continued operation of an asset.

Maintain accurate drawings, control narratives, network diagrams, logic documentation, alarm records, point lists, equipment information, test results, procedures, backups, and system-change history using consistent standards across assigned assets.
Verify the accuracy of data exchanged among SCADA, historians, measurement systems, reporting tools, SAP, PCMS, and other approved applications; prepare technical reports and recommendations for operating and business leaders.
Protect system credentials, configurations, security information, proprietary data, and other sensitive technical or commercial information in accordance with company requirements.

Work with operations, control center personnel, maintenance, engineering, integrity, safety, environmental, scheduling, information technology, vendors, and contractors to resolve issues and plan work.
Communicate technical information clearly and develop or support training, job aids, operating guidance, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge-transfer activities for employees who use or maintain automation systems.

Identify opportunities to standardize systems, improve reliability, reduce manual work, strengthen security, and improve the quality and availability of operating information.
Perform other duties and accept additional responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

To meet the basic qualifications for this role, you will have legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship.

Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, automation or controls engineering, chemical engineering, or another closely related engineering discipline.

US citizenship is required per contract.

Demonstrated experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment, including facilitating Scrum ceremonies, supporting sprint execution, removing impediments, and contributing hands-on software development.
Experience using Jira or comparable Agile project management tools to manage backlogs, user stories, defects, and sprint progress.

Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product Owners, developers, and customer stakeholders.

Experience supporting software development programs within the DoD or IC.
Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or equivalent Agile certification.
Advanced experience with Next.js, React.js, Django REST Framework, Wagtail CMS, and PostgreSQL, including performance optimization and complex application integrations.

Experience configuring and optimizing AWS ECS, S3, RDS, CloudFront, and ALB, including container orchestration, caching, security, and application performance.

Gaithersburg, MD
Alexandria, VA
Chantilly, VA
Tucson, AZ

Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, secure web and mobile applications supporting mission-critical customer requirements.
Build responsive front-end applications using Next.js, React.js, JavaScript, and CSS, and develop backend services and RESTful APIs using Python and Django.
Develop and maintain content management solutions using Wagtail CMS and optimize PostgreSQL databases for performance and data integrity.
Develop and support cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and native iOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, and Apple iOS SDKs, ensuring seamless integration with backend services.
Write clean, maintainable code; conduct peer reviews; troubleshoot complex issues; and implement unit, integration, and automated testing.

Collaborate with DevSecOps engineers to support CI/CD pipelines, Docker deployments, cloud infrastructure, and application monitoring.
Troubleshoot application and infrastructure issues while ensuring performance, reliability, and compliance with customer security requirements.

US citizenship is required per contract.

Experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile technical lead, using Agile metrics to improve sprint execution, team performance, and software delivery.
Experience mentoring developers, conducting technical reviews, and collaborating directly with government customers in mission-critical environments.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, React.js, Next.js, HTML, and CSS for front-end development and Python and Django for backend services and RESTful APIs.
Experience with Wagtail CMS or comparable content management frameworks and PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.
Experience developing cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and native iOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, and iOS SDKs.
Experience developing, deploying, and maintaining applications in AWS, including familiarity with S3, ECS, RDS, CloudFront, and Application Load Balancers (ALB).
Experience with Docker, Git-based source control, GitLab, and CI/CD development and deployment practices.
Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration concepts, including deploying, managing, and scaling containerized applications in cloud environments.
Demonstrated experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment, including facilitating Scrum ceremonies, supporting sprint execution, removing impediments, and contributing hands-on software development.
Experience using Jira or comparable Agile project management tools to manage backlogs, user stories, defects, and sprint progress.
Strong understanding of secure coding, automated testing, code reviews, software integration, and troubleshooting across full-stack applications.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product Owners, developers, and customer stakeholders.

Experience supporting software development programs within the DoD or IC.
Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or equivalent Agile certification.
Advanced experience with Next.js, React.js, Django REST Framework, Wagtail CMS, and PostgreSQL, including performance optimization and complex application integrations.
Experience developing, deploying, and maintaining native iOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, and Xcode, including application signing, provisioning, debugging, and release management.
Experience integrating React Native with native iOS components and developing mobile applications for both iOS and Android.
Experience configuring and optimizing AWS ECS, S3, RDS, CloudFront, and ALB, including container orchestration, caching, security, and application performance.
Experience with GitLab CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation, and automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Jest, or Pytest.
Experience developing secure, accessible, high-availability public-facing applications and enterprise content management solutions.
